description: Publish (or replace) the developer's public reply to a review; pass `text: ""` to delete the reply. The reply is shown in the gallery, translated into the reviewer's language when `developerLang` differs. Public text: show the developer the wording before sending.

developerLang.description: Language the reply is written in (e.g. "es"), for auto-translation

text.description: Reply text; empty string deletes the reply

name: neblla_reply_review
